checkpoint_precision: publisher BF16 checkpoint; automatic BF16 KV cache; no quantization
generation_choice_basis: Publisher sampling defaults; one fixed seed, medium thinking and 4096 total output tokens fixed before Qwen benchmark outputs; no search or test-driven changes.
prompt_policy: Pinned source task definition and complete decoded sequence(s); fixed zero-shot user prompt. Numeric assay objective and units fixed before inference. No LAB-Bench prompt or choice template is used.
metric_policy: Native task accuracy for categorical outcomes; native Spearman for the numerical assay split. Invalid/missing outputs remain explicit; no label-dependent repairs or invented numerical replacements.
paper_comparison: Verified original test rows and native task metric; prompted zero-shot full-sequence Qwen adaptation versus trained specialist/multitask systems. Same labels/split do not imply matched training or information resources.
pretraining_contamination: Unknown; local inference and shuffled choices cannot establish contamination-free performance.
